text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek bakes a huge batch of<n>madeleines to
give to her friends.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe! You're welcome.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: But... I'm in a bit of a pickle.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I made some for myself as well, but I<n>spent so
much time handing them out<n>that it's already really
late...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I can't be eating sweets at this hour...<n>But still...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Do you think it would be okay for me<n>to have
some? Just a few.
choice_data_list: Don't give in to the temptation...
How about giving them to someone else?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Okay, then just a few!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I actually had a taste, and they were<n>quite delicious,
so I've been looking<n>forward to having some more!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'll work extra hard at training<n>tomorrow to
make up for it. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek hums a tune as she<n>makes some tea
and enjoys her<n>madeleines.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: O-okay, then here I go.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You know, I've been looking forward<n>to eating
them since I was baking.<n>Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'll make some tea while I'm at it.<n>Would you
like some too?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek hums to herself as she<n>makes some
tea and happily digs into<n>her madeleines.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ack... You're right...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'll save them for tomorrow morning<n>or something.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fight the urge, fight the urge!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek squeezes her eyes shut<n>and stops
herself from eating the<n>madeleines.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Come to think of it... Oguri looked<n>like she
wanted more when I gave<n>her some earlier.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'll have her eat my share.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Mmm... I can't wait to see her stuff<n>her face.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, Super Creek enjoys<n>watching Oguri Cap
munch on the<n>madeleines.
